'''Two Deer''' is a [[wolf]].

==Activities==
Two Deer, along with [[Smoke]] and [[Winter Dawn]], are wolves known to [[Perrin Aybara]]. When [[Rand al'Thor]], [[Hurin]] and [[Loial]] disappear from [[Ingtar Shinowa]]'s camp, Perrin asks the wolves to help search for the [[Horn of Valere]] which was stolen by [[Padan Fain]].{{ref/book|2|14}}
